title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy misjudge each other across a season of balls, letters and family embarrassments in Regency England.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess with a fierce sense of self takes a post at Thornfield Hall, where its brooding master keeps a secret in the attic.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: On the Yorkshire moors, the foundling Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw share a love so wild it ruins two families over two generations.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
description: London and Paris before and during the French Revolution, told through a doctor freed from the Bastille, his daughter and two men who love her.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
description: The orphan Pip receives a fortune from a mysterious benefactor and learns, slowly, what it costs to become a gentleman.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man stays unchanged while his portrait ages and darkens with every cruelty he commits.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist gives life to a creature built from the dead, then abandons it, and the creature comes looking for an answer.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
description: A Victorian inventor travels to the year 802,701 and finds humanity split into the gentle Eloi and the underground Morlocks.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
description: Martian cylinders land in the English countryside and their heat-rays and tripods overwhelm everything humanity can throw at them.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Ishmael signs on to the whaler Pequod, whose captain Ahab has sworn to hunt down the white whale that took his leg.

title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
author: Jules Verne
description: A professor and his companions are taken aboard the submarine Nautilus and tour the oceans with the enigmatic Captain Nemo.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
description: The precise Phileas Fogg wagers his fortune that he can circle the globe in eighty days, with his valet Passepartout in tow.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: Young Jim Hawkins finds a pirate map and sails for buried treasure, with the charming and dangerous Long John Silver aboard.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Twelve cases for the consulting detective of Baker Street, from a royal blackmail to a red-headed league.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: A legend of a spectral hound haunts the Baskerville family, and Holmes sends Watson onto the moor to find the truth.

title: The Moonstone
author: Wilkie Collins
description: A cursed Indian diamond vanishes from a country house on the night of a birthday party, and several narrators try to explain how.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Told through diaries and letters, a band of friends tracks an ancient Transylvanian count who has come to London.

title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
description: A respected London doctor and a violent stranger named Hyde turn out to share a secret.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole into a world of riddles, croquet with flamingos and a very bad-tempered queen.

title: Grimms' Fairy Tales
author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm
description: Sixty-two folk tales collected by the Brothers Grimm, including Hansel and Gretel, Rapunzel and Rumpelstiltskin.

title: On the Origin of Species
author: Charles Darwin
description: Darwin's argument that species change over generations through natural selection, built from decades of observation.

title: The Voyage of the Beagle
author: Charles Darwin
description: Darwin's journal of five years at sea, from the Cape Verde islands to the Galápagos, full of geology, animals and people.

title: Relativity: The Special and General Theory
author: Albert Einstein
description: Einstein explains special and general relativity for readers without advanced mathematics.

title: Calculus Made Easy
author: Silvanus P. Thompson
description: A friendly, plain-spoken introduction to differential and integral calculus. "What one fool can do, another can."
